notes.title: Update 6.1 18-05-2025
notes.content:
Update 6.1 18-05-2025

[h2][b]Dear gamers,[/b][/h2]

After a while no news, some things have been changed in the game
We have removed Rebirth, because it takes a lot of time to build up your farm.
And we think it's a waste of time and a waste of game experience.
Instead of a Rebirth system, we have made a nicer alternative
Some benefits such as auto Play which makes playing much easier, available right from the start, does cost game money to elicit them.
And per pear it will cost you a lot of money, if you don't have money you can just click Manuel so your game will never fall dead.
Instead of Rebirth we have created a bonus system as soon as you have a certain amount of bonus points you get a bonus every time you have a bonus points you get another bonus.
These bonuses range from Cash bonuses to speed up bonuses or extra fields or animals.
Depending on what you have already elicited in the game.
These changes were made based on game testing. The testes wanted the auto Play to be available earlier, We looked at how we could achieve this.
We are happy with the results of the game 

The next update will come next week, we will continue this week with the new changes in the game so that everything works properly.
We hope to see you again at the next Update of :

IDLE Farm tycoon 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45492772/44167bb4ce71449602b28c38f3c2d28c1b02eeb8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45492772/7615140c7865cb5a476052bd8111032654df1910.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Farm news 21-4-2025
notes.content:
[h2][b]Farm news[/b][/h2]

Unfortunately we have had to move the release date to [u]week 22 which is 26 May to 30 May[/u]
We weren't ready to release the game yet, the things we wanted in it aren't quite there yet and to avoid disappointments at launch, we decided to postpone it.

[b][h3]How is it now:[/h3][/b]
We have added the Sheep farm and the horse farm to the game.
Only after the launch will the fruit trees be added, they are not in a hurry yet.
Which fruit trees can you expect the Apple, Pear, orange, banana 
Maybe there will be more 😊

Set the difficulty level, we want to have this in before the launch, this is to give everyone a fun playing pleasure, after all, it has to remain fun.
We have also removed some mistakes, this will remain so until we launch.
We have adjusted the rebirth page, which caused production to stop when you went there, and you had to turn it on again. We didn't think this was appropriate and have adjusted it so that this doesn't happen anymore, the production continues when you go to the rebirth page.

We will continue to work on the game, our tester will also come for new points of improvement and we will add these to the game.

So now you are up to date with the state of affairs, we hope to come up with version 7.0 next weekend, April 27. 
We expect to release version 8.0 on May 11th
[u][h3][b]We plan to release the game on May 28th with version 10.0[/b][/h3][/u]
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 6.1 klikt als muziek
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]New Update No. 6.1 [/b][/u][/h1]
In this update, we have addressed a number of things to get better playing fun.
We also removed a number of bugs (errors) during the test run of the game.

[h3]First of all, the new things we have put in.[/h3]

1 background music on all pages 
1a Of course we have put a butten in the main menu that can turn off the background music.
1b animal sounds added to certain buttons, which gives more atmosphere to the game.
     Added 2 Resume buts to the menu for when you want to turn off the music and go back to the game.
3 This was a big challenge, At rebirth page you couldn't choose which update you wanted at first, to  
    increase the fun we have adjusted it, you can choose any update you want. That gives you an extra 
    advantage if you approach it conveniently.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45492772/3ef541f825a4e5afbddcd725cf72c68cc3e68fb1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45492772/3f59f217ece8a0a40de810a38f3dd9f7a353f1a3.png[/img][/url]
[u][h3]And now the errors we found during testing.[/h3][/u]

1 Start butting appears when the wheat production is finished.
2 Rebirth points are only added after production is finished, this indicates an incorrect value in the total 
   number of points.
3 Rebirth does not remain the first time you do an update, it will disappear in the rebirth screen, but you 
   have received the update.

[h3][u]Upcoming game update: 7.1 we have prepared the following:[/u][/h3]
•	Difficulty Setting Degree, Easy, Normal, Hard

•	Adding Sheep to the game takes it a step further.
•	Adding a horse to the game 
•	Removing errors and further optimizing the game and improving the game play.
